title: Clinton-era investigation finds 40 tons of Nazi gold shipped from Lisbon

tellings.quote: short while. They found 40 tons of gold. 40 tons of gold that had been shipped out of the Bank of Lisbon by submarine.

plain: An author and researcher named Peter Levenda, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that an investigation under the Clinton administration in the 1990s found 40 tons of Nazi gold that had been shipped out of the Bank of Lisbon, in Portugal, by submarine, during the 1940s. He tells it as a trace of where hidden wartime wealth went, with places such as Macau, China and Indonesia in the background, which would matter if that money quietly funded things after the war.
